name: Rummaging Rodent
skill: On Normal Summon: draw 1 card.

name: Crypt Bat
skill: Swap places with any Unit you control on the board.

name: Flaming Jack Rabbit
skill: If this card would be discarded or destroyed, shuffle it into your deck instead of sending it to the Discard pile.

name: Cinder Bat
skill: On Death: adjacent Lava Dwellers add +1 to their next roll this turn; adjacent non-Lava Dwellers subtract 1 from their next roll this turn.

name: Disembodied Hand
skill: Roll this Unit's die. On a 1, 3 or 5, look at the top card of your opponent's deck and return it to the top.

name: Graveyard Wraith
skill: Dungeon Dwellers in the 8 adjacent squares add +1 to their rolls.

name: Ash Skink
skill: On Normal Summon: draw 1 card.

name: Undead Hound
skill: When destroyed: search your deck for a Tier 1 or Tier 2 Dungeon Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Ember Wisp
skill: When destroyed: search your deck for a Tier 1 or Tier 2 Lava Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Grave Snare
skill: When this Unit is attacked while face down: after the battle resolves, the attacking Unit subtracts 2 from its next roll this turn.

name: Immolation Trap
skill: When this Unit is attacked while face down: after the battle resolves, destroy both this Unit and the attacking Unit.

name: Grave Shifter
skill: Swap places with any Unit on the board, yours or your opponent's.

name: Immovable Bog
skill: Dungeon and Forest Dwellers in the 8 adjacent squares add +1 to their rolls. All other Dweller Types in those squares subtract 3.

name: Molten Field
skill: Lava Dwellers in the 8 adjacent squares add +1 to their rolls. At the start of your Recruitment Phase, Special Summon 1 Wisp Token (T1 Lava, ranged, movable, d6) to an empty Barracks square you control.

name: Cinder Skeleton
skill: During your Recruitment Phase: you may attach this card from your hand to an adjacent Lava Dweller you control as a Ride. This does not use your Normal Summon.

name: Bone Diviner
skill: Discard this card from your hand, then roll a d6. On 1 to 4, every Unit your opponent controls of the corresponding Tier subtracts 2 from its rolls until the end of their next turn. On 5 or 6, nothing happens.

name: Magma Mine
skill: Discard this card from your hand, then roll a d6. On 1 to 4, destroy 1 Unit your opponent controls of the corresponding Tier. On 5 or 6, nothing happens.

name: Skeletal Mage
skill: Once per turn: roll this Unit's die. On a 7 or 8, mill the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

name: Shallow Grave
skill: Mandatory. Every Recruitment Phase: Special Summon 1 Zombie Token (T1 Dungeon, melee, movable, d6) to an empty Barracks square you control. This is not optional.

name: Undead Mare
skill: If a Tier 1 Unit Rides this card, the stack adds +2 to its roll in battle.

name: Ghoul Rider
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon a Unit one Tier higher than the stack's highest Tier from your hand.

name: Slagborn
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon a Unit one Tier higher than the stack's highest Tier from your hand.

name: Goblin Bomb Carrier
skill: When this Unit is destroyed by an opponent's card: add 1 Magma Mine from your deck to your hand.

name: Flesh Collector
skill: Cleave - when this Unit wins a combat roll, also destroy 1 enemy Unit orthogonally adjacent to the Unit it defeated.

name: Dungeon Door
skill: This Unit and adjacent Units you control add +1 to their rolls, regardless of Dweller Type.

name: Charnel Warden
skill: Once per turn during your Recruitment Phase: banish 1 card from your Discard pile to Special Summon 1 Zombie Token (T1 Dungeon, melee, movable, d6) to an empty Barracks square you control.

name: Ashen Lancer
skill: When this Unit moves during the Battle Phase, every Unit you control adjacent to it moves the same number of squares in the same direction. This does not use those Units' own movement.

name: Ash Golem
skill: This Unit adds +1 to its roll for each Wisp Token adjacent to it.

name: Ashlands
skill: Dungeon and Lava Dwellers in the 8 adjacent squares add +2 to their rolls. No penalty to anything else.

name: Lich King
skill: Once per turn during your Recruitment Phase: Special Summon 1 Tier 1 Dungeon Dweller from your Discard pile to an empty Barracks square.

name: Corrupted Paladin
skill: Once per turn: roll this Unit's die. On an even result, destroy 1 Unit your opponent controls. On an odd result, banish 1 Unit from your opponent's Discard pile.

name: Zombie Token
skill: Token. Not part of your deck. Cannot be Set face-down. Cannot be Tributed.

name: Wisp Token
skill: Token. Not part of your deck. Cannot be Set face-down. Cannot be Tributed.

name: Skeleton Knight Token
skill: Token. Not part of your deck. Cannot be Set face-down. Cannot be Tributed.

name: Charnel Reaper
skill: Banish 2 cards from your Discard pile: Special Summon 2 Zombie Tokens (T1 Dungeon, melee, movable, d6) to empty squares adjacent to this Unit.

name: Bone Harvester
skill: Discard up to 3 cards from your hand: Special Summon that many Zombie Tokens (T1 Dungeon, melee, movable, d6) to an empty Barracks square you control.

name: Charnel Sovereign
skill: Special Summon up to 4 Skeleton Knight Tokens (T2 Dungeon, melee, movable, d8) to an empty Barracks square you control. Pay the cost in any combination of banishing Dungeon Dwellers from your Discard pile, discarding from your hand, or milling from your deck.

skill: On Normal Summon: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 to Tier 3 Dungeon Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Cinder Stalker
skill: On Normal Summon: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 to Tier 3 Lava Dweller and add it to your hand.

skill: Discard this card from your hand: search your deck for 1 Tier 1 to Tier 4 Lava Dweller and add it to your hand.

name: Emberwright

name: Tower of Bones
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon a Unit one Tier higher than the stack's highest Tier from your Discard pile or deck.

name: Pyre
skill: Sacrifice a Ride stack you control: Special Summon a Unit one Tier higher than the stack's highest Tier from your Discard pile or deck.

skill: Once per turn: add 1 Magma Mine from your deck or Discard pile to your hand.

name: Undead Drake
